Contracture not brief muscle tensing, pressure injury not bedbound-only, heat illness not abrupt-temperature heat shock; symptom/episode/context-dependent pain-distress/shortness of breath, person words and known scope rather than word-only diagnosis.

Contact norovirus/O157, droplet influenza, airborne TB/measles remain textbook route examples rather than one-pathogen-one-precaution sufficiency; pathogen/task/current institution guidance governs.

Collective-living contact and import/export/internal spread separately prevented, hand hygiene/environment-items/staff coordination under institution procedure, low resistance attention not exemption for healthy people.
